parsed.why: Most Protective tier: GENDA, 2024 constitutional ban, hate-crime coverage, shield law protecting visiting care patients, no facility ban, repealed loitering law. Only residual exposure is the national border/document regime capping the score.

Moderate-risk tier: no adult facility or care ban and municipal protections cover 46% of population, but no statewide gender-identity nondiscrimination or hate-crime coverage, so a visitor has no recourse; burdensome marker paperwork.

Worst-law tier: 2025 facilities ban in state-owned buildings, top court barred birth-certificate marker change, no gender-identity discrimination or hate-crime coverage, solitary-confinement prospect in custody.

Most Protective tier since 2006: gender-identity discrimination ban, hate-crime coverage, panic-defence repeal, shield law explicitly protecting visitors travelling for care, gender-neutral restrooms, easy marker change.

Most restrictive: executive order enforces birth-sex facilities across state buildings, shelters and custody; care provision criminalised for state employees; no state discrimination or hate-crime protection — universal exposure without remedy.
